geometry.law: Geometry is identical across every colour variant. Only colour treatment may differ.

brandVariants.name: Star — brand red
brandVariants.intendedUse: primary site logo on dark backgrounds (world HUD, blog header, loading surface); also safe on light backgrounds

brandVariants.name: Star — red-hot gradient
brandVariants.treatment: radial gradient, white-hot core into deep red (the RED MAGIC iris ramp)
brandVariants.intendedUse: identity surfaces that want heat: loading screen, favicon companion, social artwork

brandVariants.name: Star — crimson
brandVariants.intendedUse: quiet brand accents, pressed/hover logo states, print-adjacent uses

brandVariants.name: Star — white
brandVariants.intendedUse: brand mark on dark or red surfaces; monochrome lockups

brandVariants.name: Star — black
brandVariants.intendedUse: brand mark on white/light surfaces, documents, monochrome lockups

brandVariants.name: Star — silver
brandVariants.intendedUse: neutral brand accents on dark UI where pure white is too loud

brandVariants.name: Star — dark neutral
brandVariants.intendedUse: quiet brand watermark on light UI; dark-on-light lockups

brandVariants.name: Star — red outline (transparent fill)
brandVariants.intendedUse: transparent-stroke variant: layered identity compositions, watermarks, decorative echoes of the solid star

brandVariants.name: Star — white outline (transparent fill)
brandVariants.intendedUse: transparent-stroke variant for dark surfaces: layered compositions, watermarks, ghost echoes

glyphs.title: Brand star glyph
glyphs.purpose: inline brand mark that inherits text colour (footer, small UI)

glyphs.title: Brand star glyph, outlined
glyphs.purpose: quiet/secondary brand mark that inherits text colour

glyphs.title: Concentric star
glyphs.purpose: identity motif for section markers and article-body system diagrams

glyphs.title: Star grid
glyphs.purpose: pattern glyph: catalogue/library ornament representing the asset system

glyphs.title: Orbit ring
glyphs.purpose: state/sync motif: scheduled systems, world signals, telemetry notes

glyphs.title: Signal node
glyphs.purpose: communication/agent-signal motif for diagrams and UI markers

glyphs.title: Research glyph
glyphs.purpose: research/measurement marker (UHIT, benchmark and study notes)

glyphs.title: AI glyph
glyphs.purpose: AI-systems marker (agent networks, model notes, capability context)

glyphs.title: Link glyph
glyphs.purpose: link/reference marker for article bodies and navigation UI

glyphs.title: Arrow right

glyphs.title: Arrow up-right
